name: cardentry
description: Recognise trading cards from photos and export the stack as a CSV file for Cardmarket TCG PowerTools.

interface.longDescription: CardEntry recognises trading cards from photos and turns a stack into a CSV file for Cardmarket TCG PowerTools. From the chat you can start a new stack and get the links to add photos in the CardEntry web app or with your phone camera, see which cards still need a look, correct a card by searching the catalog, and export the finished stack. CardEntry covers Magic, Pokémon, Yu-Gi-Oh!, One Piece, Lorcana and other games. Only the sessions of your connected CardEntry account are accessible. CardEntry is an independent tool with no business relationship to Cardmarket or TCG PowerTools.
defaultPrompt: Start a new Pokémon stack in CardEntry.
Which cards in my latest CardEntry stack still need a check?
Export my latest CardEntry stack for TCG PowerTools.

positive.expected_behavior: List the sessions of the test account with game, number of cards and a link to each session.

positive.prompt: Start a new Pokémon stack in CardEntry.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a Pokémon session and return the links to add photos in the web app and with the phone camera.

positive.prompt: Which cards in my latest CardEntry stack still need a check?
positive.expected_behavior: Open the newest session of the test account and name the cards that are not confirmed yet.

positive.prompt: In my latest CardEntry stack, the first card is actually Pikachu ex from Surging Sparks, number 238. Please fix it.
positive.expected_behavior: Search the catalog for the named card, assign the matching print to the first card and confirm the change.

positive.prompt: Export my latest CardEntry stack for TCG PowerTools.
positive.expected_behavior: Export the confirmed cards of the newest session and return the CSV for TCG PowerTools.
